technical.summary: PCAR shows solid structural bullish alignment with price above all major MAs and rising RSI across all periods, but lacks strong trending confirmation (ADX 21.98) and active momentum crossovers, making this a moderate-quality swing entry dependent on near-term price action confirmation.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider or institutional signals with 91 days to earnings provides neutral positioning but insufficient conviction data for directional bias.

sentiment.summary: Fear sentiment with neutral AAII positioning presents contrarian buy opportunity; no congressional signals to confirm or contradict.

risk.summary: FOMC decision in 1 day with elevated VIX (31.16) creates substantial event risk; new swing trade entry inadvisable.

debate.key_bull_argument: PCAR demonstrates solid technical structure with price above all major moving averages, rising RSI across all timeframes, and bullish supertrend alignment, supported by contrarian fear-zone sentiment presenting asymmetric upside opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: FOMC decision in 1 day combined with elevated VIX (31.16) and weak directional strength (ADX 21.98) creates unacceptable event risk that outweighs moderate technical quality and absent fundamental/insider conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Moderate technical structure insufficient to overcome imminent FOMC event risk and elevated macro uncertainty with no smart money conviction.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC decision in 1 day with VIX at 31.16 creates unacceptable event risk that could invalidate technical setup regardless of entry quality.
